title: Pumpkin and the journey of light
summary: A 28 s wordless illustrated short: a tiny orange box-pumpkin character on a cream paper ground watches a spark of light, and a circular iris portal takes us on a continuous journey through neurons, a prism rainbow, concentric rainbow rings, a sunflower, a galaxy, a black hole and a tunnel of rings, before Earth rises and the light returns to the character. Whimsical, painterly, one continuous morphing flow.
fit_reason: Beautiful 'one shape morphs into the next' storytelling, but the whimsical cartoon/cosmic tone doesn't fit a plain, direct B2B agency brand.

palette.mood: warm cream paper against deep navy space, full-spectrum rainbow accents

motion: circular iris/portal wipe opens from the paper world into space
continuous morph: neuron branches -> light beam -> prism -> rainbow rings -> sunflower -> petals scatter -> galaxy -> black hole
tunnel zoom through concentric neon rings
character idle bounce and curious reactions
signature_moves: circle as the throughline that every scene morphs from
iris portal from flat cream world into glowing space
small character as observer and bookend

best_segments.what: Prism beam becomes rainbow rings that become a sunflower: continuous circular morph

recreate.how: Hand-animated 2D (After Effects / Rive) with particle work; the circular morph idea alone can be done in HTML+GSAP with SVG circles and stroke animation.
recreate.prompt: Cream paper world with a tiny orange character; a circular iris opens into navy space and a single glowing circle morphs continuously through prism, rainbow rings, sunflower, galaxy and black hole, then returns as a spark to the character; gentle score, no text.
